entries.title: On a phone, the first tap on a dot reads it; the second opens it

values.label: the first tap opens the dot's card, with Open the race → in it; a second tap on the dot also opens (new)
no button: the card says tap again, and a second tap on the dot opens

entries.look: On the phone, tap any dot on the season chart: its card opens above it (below it near the top of the screen) and you stay on the page. Tap the card's Open the race →, or the same dot again, to open the race; tap another dot to move the card, anywhere else to close it. The same on every chart that had a hover: Career's climb, chapters, explorer, rivals, restarts, rain days, campaign arcs and globe, a race page's lap chart and team strip, the Race Week charts. On the laptop nothing changes.
